I segni mammografici di malignità di una:
The mammographic signs of malignancy of a mass are irregular shape, non-circumscribed margins (indistinct, microlobulated or spiculated) and high density. A mass with these characteristics, visible in both views, should be classified BI-RADS 4C-5 and biopsied (ultrasound-guided core needle biopsy, if visible on ultrasound).
Remember to always compare right and left and to look at the mass in both views in order to localize it.
The histologic outcome is breast carcinoma; the Luminal A molecular subtype (hormone receptor positive, HER2 negative, low Ki-67) is the most frequent and has the most favorable prognosis.
